text: Hi there! Here is your weather report for Tuesday, October 27. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Shanghai is going to be a little bit rainy today. It will reach 20 degrees, and drop down to 14 degrees. A mild sort of day, easy to be outside in. The chance of rain is 10 percent. Here's something to notice: today is about 3 degrees cooler than yesterday. Will you need an extra layer? Listen out for the rain on the window today. It sounds like tiny drums. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be overcast, reaching 20 degrees. Tell someone about trying something hard today. That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
